posts.en:
dsh-youreyes is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Vision toolkit for text-only DeepSeek: model-invokable `vision` tool, wrapper adapters for deepseek/opencode-go (v4 flash/pro), Antigravity IDE quota (default, flash/pro) / any OpenAI-compatible VLM / Gemini / local Ollama channels, evidence memory with compaction rehydration, content-hash cache, and a bilingual client panel.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-a182a7063eb2ee0139f3.html
